const readmeConfig = {
    name: "react-form-helper",
    summary: "<h4>概述</h4>\n<p><code>@kne/react-form-helper</code> 桥接任意 UI 输入组件与 <code>@kne/react-form</code>：用 decorator hooks 完成字段注册与校验触发，用 <code>useUIDecorator</code> 渲染 label / 错误态，并用一组 widget 补齐滚动到错误、回车提交、草稿缓存、label 对齐、尺寸下发等能力。</p>\n<h4>主要特性</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>装饰器</strong>：<code>useDecorator</code> / <code>useOnBlur</code> / <code>useOnChange</code> 一键把 UI 控件接到表单字段</li>\n<li><strong>布尔控件</strong>：<code>withChecked</code> 适配 Checkbox、Switch 等 <code>checked</code> 语义</li>\n<li><strong>字段 UI</strong>：统一的 label、必填标记、tips、description、错误文案布局（含多行错误占位）</li>\n<li><strong>Widget</strong>：<code>ScrollToError</code>、<code>EnterSubmit</code>、<code>FormStore</code>、<code>MaxLabelProvider</code>、<code>SizeProvider</code></li>\n<li><strong>preset</strong>：可按字段名合并默认 props</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>使用场景</h4>\n<ul>\n<li>自建表单组件库（不必依赖 <code>@kne/react-form-antd</code>）</li>\n<li>在业务里用 antd / 其它 UI 库快速包一层 Form 字段</li>\n<li>需要草稿缓存、回车提交、校验失败自动滚动等表单交互增强</li>\n</ul>",
    description: "react-form的辅助工具包",
    keywords: ["react","form","validate"],
    packageName: "@kne/react-form-helper",
    api: "<h4>hooks</h4>\n<p>通过 <code>import { hooks } from '@kne/react-form-helper'</code> 使用。</p>\n<h5>useDecorator</h5>\n<p>默认装饰器：失焦校验；传入 <code>realtime</code> 时改为带 debounce 的变更校验，并渲染字段外壳（label / 错误）。</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>name</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>字段名（必填，透传 <code>useField</code>）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>rule</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>校验规则串，如 <code>REQ EMAIL</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>label</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>字段标签</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>realtime</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>为 true 时按变更校验（默认 debounce 500ms）</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>description</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>控件下方说明文案</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>labelTips</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode | function</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>标签旁提示</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>labelRender</td>\n<td><code>function</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>自定义 label 渲染</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>labelHidden</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>隐藏 label</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>important</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>强制显示/隐藏必填星号；默认根据规则是否含 <code>REQ</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>ignoreLabelWidth</td>\n<td><code>boolean</code></td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>跳过 <code>MaxLabelProvider</code> 的 minWidth</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>fieldName</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>用于 <code>preset</code> 按字段类型合并默认 props</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>...</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>其余 props 透传给底层 UI 组件</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>返回值为 render 函数：<code>const render = useDecorator(props); return render(Input);</code></p>\n<h5>useOnBlur / useOnChange</h5>\n<p>与 <code>useDecorator</code> 相同的 UI 外壳，但校验时机固定：</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>API</th>\n<th>校验时机</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>useOnBlur</code></td>\n<td>失焦时 <code>triggerValidate</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>useOnChange</code></td>\n<td>值变化后 <code>triggerValidate</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h5>useBlurDecorator / useChangeDecorator</h5>\n<p>底层装饰器，一般不必直接使用；分别把 <code>onBlur</code> / <code>onChange</code> 接到 <code>triggerValidate</code>。</p>\n<h5>useUIDecorator</h5>\n<p>把 <code>useField</code> 产出的字段状态渲染成 <code>.react-form__field</code> 结构（label、description、<code>.react-form__field-error</code>）。被上述 decorator 内部调用。</p>\n<h5>useFieldProps</h5>\n<p>在字段控件树内读取当前字段完整 props（由 <code>FieldPropsProvider</code> 注入），便于子组件感知 <code>name</code> / <code>errState</code> 等。</p>\n<h5>useCacheRemove</h5>\n<p>须在 <code>Form</code> 内使用。返回函数，调用后发出 <code>form-widget:store:remove</code>，配合 <code>FormStore</code> 清除本地草稿。</p>\n<h5>useField</h5>\n<p>从 <code>@kne/react-form</code> 再导出，便于与 helper 同包引用。</p>\n<hr>\n<h4>hoc</h4>\n<h5>withChecked</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th></th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>作用</td>\n<td>把表单 <code>value</code> 映射为 UI 的 <code>checked</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>用法</td>\n<td><code>const CheckboxUI = withChecked(Checkbox);</code> 再交给 <code>useDecorator</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><code>useCheckedToValue</code> 为反向映射（<code>checked</code> → <code>value</code>），多用于自定义受控逻辑。</p>\n<hr>\n<h4>widget</h4>\n<h5>ScrollToError</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>scrollProps</td>\n<td><code>object</code></td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>传给首个错误字段 <code>fieldRef.scrollIntoView</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>监听 <code>form:submit:error</code>，滚动到第一个错误字段。</p>\n<h5>EnterSubmit</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>type</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td><code>'div'</code></td>\n<td>包裹元素类型</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>表单内容</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>在容器内按下 Enter（keyCode 13）时触发 <code>form:submit</code>。</p>\n<h5>FormStore</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>cache</td>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>本地缓存 key 后缀（必填）</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>字段变更写入 localStorage；<code>form:submit:success</code> 或 <code>useCacheRemove</code> 时清除。</p>\n<h5>MaxLabelProvider</h5>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>属性</th>\n<th>类型</th>\n<th>默认值</th>\n<th>描述</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>minLabelWidth</td>\n<td><code>number</code></td>\n<td><code>0</code></td>\n<td>label 最小宽度</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>children</td>\n<td><code>ReactNode</code></td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>表单字段区域</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>按当前字段 label 文本计算最大宽度并对齐。表单带 <code>react-form--inner</code> 时自动跳过（label 在上、控件在下）。</p>\n<h5>SizeProvider</h5>\n<p>即 React Context Provider，<code>value={{ size }}</code>，<code>size</code> 为 <code>'small' \\| 'middle' \\| 'large'</code>。子字段经     title: "基本示例",
    description: "用 useDecorator 把 antd Input 接到 @kne/react-form",
    code: "const { createWithRemoteLoader } = remoteLoader;\nconst { hooks } = _ReactFormHelper;\nconst { default: Form, useSubmit } = _ReactForm;\nconst { Input: InputField, Button, Flex } = antd;\n\nconst { useDecorator } = hooks;\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const render = useDecorator(Object.assign({ placeholder: `请输入${props.label}` }, props));\n  return render(InputField);\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ type = 'primary', realtime, disabled = false, ...props }) => {\n  const { isPass, isLoading, ...submitProps } = useSubmit(props);\n  return <Button type={type} loading={isLoading} disabled={disabled || (realtime ? !isPass : false)} {...props} {...submitProps} />;\n};\n\nconst BaseExample = createWithRemoteLoader({\n  modules: ['InfoPage', 'Modal@useConfirmModal']\n})(({ remoteModules }) => {\n  const [InfoPage, useConfirmModal] = remoteModules;\n  const modal = useConfirmModal();\n\n  return (\n    <InfoPage>\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"useDecorator 绑定 antd Input\">\n        <Form\n          onSubmit={data => {\n            modal({ type: 'info', message: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) });\n          }}\n        >\n          <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>\n            <Input name=\"name\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ LEN-0-20\" />\n            <Input name=\"email\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"REQ EMAIL\" />\n            <Input name=\"mobile\" label=\"手机号\" rule=\"REQ LEN-11-11\" description=\"失焦后触发校验（默认行为）\" />\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          </Flex>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n    </InfoPage>\n  );\n});\n\nrender(<BaseExample />);\n\n",

    title: "校验时机",
    description: "对照 useOnBlur / useOnChange / useDecorator(realtime) 的触发时机",
    code: "const { createWithRemoteLoader } = remoteLoader;\nconst { hooks } = _ReactFormHelper;\nconst { default: Form, useSubmit } = _ReactForm;\nconst { Input: InputField, Button, Flex, Alert } = antd;\n\nconst { useDecorator, useOnChange, useOnBlur } = hooks;\n\nconst BlurInput = props => {\n  const render = useOnBlur(Object.assign({ placeholder: `请输入${props.label}` }, props));\n  return render(InputField);\n};\n\nconst ChangeInput = props => {\n  const render = useOnChange(Object.assign({ placeholder: `请输入${props.label}` }, props));\n  return render(InputField);\n};\n\nconst RealtimeInput = props => {\n  const render = useDecorator(Object.assign({ placeholder: `请输入${props.label}`, realtime: true }, props));\n  return render(InputField);\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ type = 'primary', ...props }) => {\n  const { isLoading, ...submitProps } = useSubmit(props);\n  return <Button type={type} loading={isLoading} {...props} {...submitProps} />;\n};\n\nconst DecoratorsExample = createWithRemoteLoader({\n  modules: ['InfoPage', 'Modal@useConfirmModal']\n})(({ remoteModules }) => {\n  const [InfoPage, useConfirmModal] = remoteModules;\n  const modal = useConfirmModal();\n  const onSubmit = data => modal({ type: 'info', message: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) });\n\n  return (\n    <InfoPage>\n      <Alert\n        type=\"info\"\n        showIcon\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        message=\"校验时机\"\n        description=\"useOnBlur：失焦校验；useOnChange：值变化后校验；useDecorator(realtime)：带 debounce 的变更校验。\"\n      />\n\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"useOnBlur（失焦校验）\">\n        <Form onSubmit={onSubmit}>\n          <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>\n            <BlurInput name=\"blurName\" label=\"姓名\" rule=\"REQ LEN-2-10\" />\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          </Flex>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"useOnChange（变更即校验）\">\n        <Form onSubmit={onSubmit}>\n          <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>\n            <ChangeInput name=\"changeEmail\" label=\"邮箱\" rule=\"REQ EMAIL\" />\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          </Flex>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"useDecorator realtime\">\n        <Form onSubmit={onSubmit}>\n          <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>\n            <RealtimeInput name=\"rtTitle\" label=\"标题\" rule=\"REQ LEN-0-12\" />\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          </Flex>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n    </InfoPage>\n  );\n});\n\nrender(<DecoratorsExample />);\n\n",

    title: "Checkbox / Switch",
    description: "withChecked 把 value 映射为 checked，适配 antd 布尔控件",
    code: "const { createWithRemoteLoader } = remoteLoader;\nconst { hooks, hoc } = _ReactFormHelper;\nconst { default: Form, useSubmit } = _ReactForm;\nconst { Checkbox: CheckboxField, Switch: SwitchField, Button, Flex, Alert } = antd;\n\nconst { useDecorator } = hooks;\nconst { withChecked } = hoc;\n\nconst CheckboxUI = withChecked(CheckboxField);\nconst SwitchUI = withChecked(SwitchField);\n\nconst Checkbox = props => {\n  const render = useDecorator(props);\n  return render(CheckboxUI);\n};\n\nconst Switch = props => {\n  const render = useDecorator(props);\n  return render(SwitchUI);\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ type = 'primary', ...props }) => {\n  const { isLoading, ...submitProps } = useSubmit(props);\n  return <Button type={type} loading={isLoading} {...props} {...submitProps} />;\n};\n\nconst CheckedExample = createWithRemoteLoader({\n  modules: ['InfoPage', 'Modal@useConfirmModal']\n})(({ remoteModules }) => {\n  const [InfoPage, useConfirmModal] = remoteModules;\n  const modal = useConfirmModal();\n\n  return (\n    <InfoPage>\n      <Alert\n        type=\"info\"\n        showIcon\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        message=\"withChecked\"\n        description=\"antd Checkbox / Switch 使用 checked，表单字段使用 value。withChecked 把 value 映射为 checked，再交给 useDecorator。\"\n      />\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"Checkbox / Switch\">\n        <Form\n          data={{ agree: false, notify: true }}\n          onSubmit={data => modal({ type: 'info', message: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) })}\n        >\n          <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>\n            <Checkbox name=\"agree\" label=\"同意协议\" rule=\"REQ\">\n              我已阅读并同意用户协议\n            </Checkbox>\n            <Switch name=\"notify\" label=\"消息通知\" />\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          </Flex>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n    </InfoPage>\n  );\n});\n\nrender(<CheckedExample />);\n\n",

    title: "字段 UI",

    code: "const { createWithRemoteLoader } = remoteLoader;\nconst { hooks, widget } = _ReactFormHelper;\nconst { default: Form, useSubmit } = _ReactForm;\nconst { Input: InputField, Button, Flex, Radio, Space, Alert } = antd;\nconst { useState } = React;\n\nconst { useDecorator, useFieldProps } = hooks;\nconst { MaxLabelProvider, SizeProvider } = widget;\n\nconst Input = props => {\n  const render = useDecorator(Object.assign({ placeholder: `请输入${props.label}` }, props));\n  return render(InputField);\n};\n\nconst PeekFieldProps = () => {\n  const fieldProps = useFieldProps();\n  return (\n    <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#666', marginTop: 4 }}>\n      useFieldProps：name={fieldProps.name}，errState={String(fieldProps.errState ?? '-')}\n    </div>\n  );\n};\n\nconst InputWithPeek = props => {\n  const render = useDecorator(Object.assign({ placeholder: `请输入${props.label}` }, props));\n  return render(props => (\n    <>\n      <InputField {...props} />\n      <PeekFieldProps />\n    </>\n  ));\n};\n\nconst SubmitButton = ({ type = 'primary', ...props }) => {\n  const { isLoading, ...submitProps } = useSubmit(props);\n  return <Button type={type} loading={isLoading} {...props} {...submitProps} />;\n};\n\nconst FieldUiExample = createWithRemoteLoader({\n  modules: ['InfoPage', 'Modal@useConfirmModal']\n})(({ remoteModules }) => {\n  const [InfoPage, useConfirmModal] = remoteModules;\n  const modal = useConfirmModal();\n  const [size, setSize] = useState('middle');\n  const onSubmit = data => modal({ type: 'info', message: JSON.stringify(data, null, 2) });\n\n  return (\n    <InfoPage>\n      <Alert\n        type=\"info\"\n        showIcon\n        style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}\n        message=\"字段 UI 能力\"\n        description=\"labelTips / description / important / labelHidden；MaxLabelProvider 对齐 label 列宽；SizeProvider 向控件注入 size；子控件内可用 useFieldProps。\"\n      />\n\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"label / description / tips\">\n        <Form onSubmit={onSubmit}>\n          <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 480 }}>\n            <Input name=\"title\" label=\"职位名称\" rule=\"REQ\" labelTips=\"对外展示的职位标题\" description=\"建议不超过 30 字\" important />\n            <Input name=\"code\" label=\"内部编码\" labelHidden placeholder=\"隐藏 label，仅保留输入\" />\n            <InputWithPeek name=\"owner\" label=\"负责人\" rule=\"REQ\" />\n            <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n          </Flex>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"MaxLabelProvider（label 列宽对齐）\">\n        <Form onSubmit={onSubmit}>\n          <MaxLabelProvider minLabelWidth={72}>\n            <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 480 }}>\n              <Input name=\"a\" label=\"名\" rule=\"REQ\" />\n              <Input name=\"b\" label=\"非常长的字段标签名称\" rule=\"REQ\" />\n              <Input name=\"c\" label=\"部门\" ignoreLabelWidth description=\"ignoreLabelWidth 跳过对齐\" />\n              <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n            </Flex>\n          </MaxLabelProvider>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n\n      <InfoPage.Part title=\"SizeProvider\">\n        <Space style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>\n          <Radio.Group value={size} onChange={e => setSize(e.target.value)} optionType=\"button\" buttonStyle=\"solid\">\n            <Radio.Button value=\"small\">small</Radio.Button>\n            <Radio.Button value=\"middle\">middle</Radio.Button>\n            <Radio.Button value=\"large\">large</Radio.Button>\n          </Radio.Group>\n        </Space>\n        <Form onSubmit={onSubmit}>\n          <SizeProvider value={{ size }}>\n            <Flex vertical gap=\"middle\" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>\n              <Input name=\"sizeDemo\" label=\"尺寸演示\" rule=\"REQ\" />\n              <SubmitButton>提交</SubmitButton>\n            </Flex>\n          </SizeProvider>\n        </Form>\n      </InfoPage.Part>\n    </InfoPage>\n  );\n});\n\nrender(<FieldUiExample />);\n\n",
